subject: How to save data from an input in a variable so I can use it in further functions

messages.author: 5169fc99eb6b9bcf
messages.subject: How to save data from an input in a variable so I can use it in further functions
parts:
Hello everybody,

first of all I'm new to Shiny so my knowledge is basically zero.
Right now I'm struggeling with a problem:

I want to type a number into an Input. After that I want to click on an action button which executes that the number from the Input is saved into a variable which I can use in a further function. Additonally I have an extra action button which is called calculate. Clicking on that button should trigger that he takes the variable from the first function and adds 2. After that there should be an output which shows the new number.

The thing is I want a variable which can be used further on and can be updated in further functions. The example on top is only an example to describe how I think. My Code is on the bot. Is it correct to use eventReactive() or is it better to use observe(). What is the difference between reactive and observe and when do I use them?
I really could use your help :D
Thanks alot!!
Greetz Oli

Here is my Shiny.UI:
=================
library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Dummy"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
     
      numericInput(inputId = "Number", "Put in a number", value = ""),
      actionButton(inputId = "Load", "Load the data"),
      actionButton(inputId = "Calc", "Calculate")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      verbatimTextOutput("result")
    )
  )
))

Here is my Server.r:
================
library(shiny)

hname <- 1

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
 
  #Load the Number
  #Here I save the Input into the globale variable hname which I want to use later on
   test <- eventReactive(input$Load, {
    hname <<- input$Number
    })
 
  #Here I want to take the variable hname and do a calculation with it by adding +2
  #The Function is caused  by clicking on the other Button "Calculate"
  test2 <- eventReactive(input$Calc, {hname <<- hname + 2
  return(hname)})
 
  output$result <- renderPrint({test2()})
 
})

Not really so far... but I know 2 more things:

1. You can make global variables.
You have to define them in server.r but outside the main function.
Like that:
#############################
hname <- 1 #global variable

shinyServer(function(input, output) {


hname <<- 5 # you have to put double arrow if you want to change it so it affects every function u use it in. I think its very dangerous tow ork with global variable if you work with observe() or reactive(). Cuz it changes immediately. But if you use observeevent() or eventreactive() it can be very useful cuz it only changes if you for example click the action button.

 }]
###############################

2. You can define a function as variable

name <- reactive({
input$Name  # get the input from a textfield for example

})

name() # you can use the function as variable in any other function


Those are the two solutions I discovered. If anybody has a better solution please let us know.
